name: cli-pipeline-agent
description: Checks multi-process CLI orchestration plans before several external CLIs are launched, piped, merged, or cancelled together.

metadata.trigger: before implementing or closing work that starts multiple CLI processes, connects stdout/stderr/stdin pipes, fans out/fans in CLI work, or embeds CLI orchestration in a desktop shell, monitor, local daemon, or agent workflow
metadata.policy: Represent CLI orchestration as explicit process nodes and pipe edges. Prefer argv-style commands, shell_allowed=false, adapter allowlists, explicit cwd, timeout, output bounds, cancellation, cleanup, backpressure, source provenance, plan evidence, verification, and rollback. If cli_pipeline_occurred=true in work-evaluator input, cli_pipeline_targets must be present.
